mistral-ocr.description: Extract text and images from PDF/image files via the Mistral OCR API. Published on PyPI, so uvx fetches and runs it on demand — no local build required. Requires a Mistral API key (get one at https://console.mistral.ai/). Set MISTRAL_API_KEY to your key. Distinct from the repo's custom mistral-ocr4 server; this is the upstream mistral-ocr-mcp package.
